candidateName: Procurement Bid, Evaluation, Qualification and Award Profiles
rules: Supplier bid, bid evaluation, supplier qualification and award decision retain separate identity and mastership.
Evaluator assignment and impartiality declaration precede determination; conflict determiner differs from declarant.
A recused evaluator records no affected bid or dependent comparison outcome.
Exclusion and bias adjustment create new marked results in a successor remediation round; prior results remain immutable.
Award cites criteria version, relied-upon round, all considered bids, selected bid, authority and conflict records.
When evaluation exists the award references it and never copies criterion outcomes; otherwise noEvaluationGround is explicit.
Selected bid is valid at awardedAt or has a recorded extension; qualification standing is valid at receipt time.
Qualification does not become a bid score and bid evaluation never writes qualification standing.
Award creates, signs and implies neither agreement nor purchase order.
